title: conversation-shape-latency-decomposer-with-span-linking-and-error-funnel
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build a new dashboard and supporting telemetry to decompose latency and error behavior by conversation/request shape and I/O mode (streaming vs non-streaming). This ticket covers schema changes in the metric/log pipeline, tracer span tagging conventions, backend aggregation queries, and the dashboard UX. The intent is to provide p50/p95/p99 views, streaming/non-streaming splits, and fast trace-links from any cell to the corresponding span set or logs for root-cause debugging. Secondary goal: add an error funnel panel that correlates backend component latencies with error rates and exception types so product and SRE can rapidly identify regressions after model or runtime changes.
background: Existing dashboards provide model/route percentile breakdowns and many tickets improved trace hooks, but teams still spend >30% of incident triage time reconstructing request shapes and I/O mode context. Currently we lack a single explorer that combines: (1) conversation/request shape cohorts (prompt length, messages, streaming usage), (2) percentile decomposition by serving path components (router, batcher, runtime, network), and (3) direct trace/log links for sample spans. This causes slow MTTR and noisy alerting when model changes shift token distributions or streaming adoption grows.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard exposes p50/p95/p99 for selected model + route, with toggle for streaming vs non-streaming
Cohort selector available: request token length buckets, message-count buckets, client platform, and 'streamed' boolean
Each dashboard cell has a 'View traces' action that opens a filtered trace list with the full span tree and links to raw logs
Backend aggregations compute per-component latency waterfall (router -> batcher -> runtime -> postprocess) and show contribution percentages
Error funnel panel correlates percentiles with error rate and top 3 exception types per cohort
Telemetry schema changes emitted from runtime and router are deployed with backward-compatible tags and documented
End-to-end tests cover query correctness and UX interactions; runbook updated with debug steps
technical_decisions: Store per-request 'shape' metadata in the tracing span as attributes: request.token_count, request.message_count, io.mode (stream|sync), client.platform
Emit lightweight histogram metrics (HIST buckets for latency) from the router and runtime to ClickHouse for fast OLAP queries; use trace IDs sampled to full traces for deep inspection
Use existing trace sampling policy but increase sampler for errors and 1-in-50 for high-traffic routes during rollout
Backfill: no backfill for detailed request-shape histograms; rely on fresh data post-deploy. Provide a temporary synthetic comparison using existing percentile metrics for pre-deploy baseline
Dashboard implemented in the Console as a new 'Latency Investigations' board; queries driven by paramized ClickHouse views to keep front-end light
instrumentation_tasks: Runtime: add span attribute request.token_count and exact_io_mode tag (streaming|non-streaming), increment telemetry schema version
Router/batcher: emit component timing spans with component.name and component.duration_ms
Logs: ensure error records include trace_id, model, route, and request.shape tags
Metric pipeline: add latency histogram series broken out by model, route, io_mode, and token_bucket to ClickHouse topic
Tracing: update collector to index request.shape attributes for fast lookup
SDK: surface io_mode flag and ensure frontend SDKs set streaming=true on streaming sessions
risks_and_mitigation: Increased tracer attributes may raise span size and collector load; mitigation: limit attributes to ints/short enums and monitor collector ingest; enable rollout flags per cluster
ClickHouse storage growth from histograms; mitigate by compacting buckets and TTL on high-cardinality tags
Dashboard query latency if naive aggregations used; mitigate by building pre-aggregated materialized views for top 50 routes
testing_plan: Unit tests for new span attribute serialization and collector indexing
Integration tests that emit synthetic requests across token buckets and validate p50/p95/p99 in ClickHouse matches expected
Manual QA: product-led walkthrough with 'streaming' toggle and trace-linking validation on a staging dataset
Load test: simulate 10k rps on a dedicated route to validate ClickHouse queries and tracer sampling changes
implementation_notes: Step 1 (week 1): Schema work + runtime tagging behind feature flag
Step 2 (week 2): Metric pipeline change + ClickHouse view creation
Step 3 (week 3): Dashboard UI and trace-link integration; internal dogfood on staging
Step 4 (week 4): Gradual rollout to production routes; monitor collector and CH storage; post-rollout retrospective
